claim.claim-text: a first section (211) including a first substrate and a first wiring layer (245); a second section (212) including a second substrate, a second wiring layer (230), and a third wiring layer (255); a third section (213) including a third substrate with a fourth wiring layer (345); and an electrode pad (280a), wherein the first section, the second section, and the third section are stacked such that the first wring layer and the second wiring layer face each other, and the third wiring layer and the fourth wiring layer face each other, wherein the first section and the second section are electrically connected to each other, and the second section and the third section are electrically connected to each other, wherein the second wiring layer and the third wiring layer are electrically connected to each other through a first contact, and wherein the first wiring layer includes a first wire, the second wiring layer includes a second wire, and the first wire and the second wire are directly bonded to each other.
2. The light detecting device of claim 1, wherein the first contact penetrates through the second substrate.
3. The light detecting device of claim 1 or claim 2, wherein the electrode pad is disposed in the first section.
4. The light detecting device of any preceding claim, wherein the electrode pad is disposed in the first wiring layer and is exposed by a pad hole.
5. The light detecting device of any preceding claim, wherein the electrode pad is configured to connect the light detecting device to an external device.
6. The light detecting device of any preceding claim, wherein the first substrate includes a plurality of photoelectric conversion regions.
7. The light detecting device of any preceding claim, wherein the first section and the second section are electrically connected to each other by a second contact.
8. The light detecting device of any preceding claim, wherein the second contact penetrates through the first substrate.
9. The light detecting device of any preceding claim, wherein the second contact is a twin contact.
10. The light detecting device of any preceding claim, wherein the second section and the third section are electrically connected to each other by a third contact.
11. The light detecting device of claim 10, wherein the third contact is a twin contact.
an optical unit including a lens group; and the light detecting device of any preceding claim configured to receive incident light from the optical unit.

the light detecting device of any of claims 1 to 11, wherein the first section comprises a plurality of photodiodes; the second section comprises a plurality of transistors; and the third section comprises a plurality of transistors.
